description: In projects that use sgc (a .sgc/ directory), inject the sgc bootstrap and the active task at session start.

hooks.command: D="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; [ -d "$D/.sgc" ] || exit 0; cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/bootstrap/SKILL.md" 2>/dev/null || echo 'SGC bootstrap not found'; if [ -f "$D/.sgc/progress/current-task.md" ]; then echo; echo '---'; echo '## Active sgc task (resumed from .sgc/progress/current-task.md)'; cat "$D/.sgc/progress/current-task.md"; fi
